about: T3 phone references (decision 19). Placeholder habits only (Walk, Water), made for this survey in apps we installed or our own debug builds; screenshots in the gitignored _screens-sources/t3/. Bounds in dp (1080 px = 384 dp, density 450).

habits_list.name: Loop Habit Tracker 2.3.1
habits_list.presence: score ring left of the name (fills with the habit's score)
habits_list.days_shown: the last 4 days as columns, newest first; header row with weekday and date
habits_list.missed_mark: a grey cross on every day not done (yes/no habit); 0 glasses on a counted one
habits_list.log_from_list: tap a day cell: a popup with a note field and two buttons, tick and cross (yesBtn [88,422,103,48], noBtn [192,422,103,48]); the cell itself is [189,133,48,48]

habits_list.name: Tendril (source app)
habits_list.days_shown: one day at a time (previous and next day arrows, the day's name)
habits_list.done_mark: a checkbox (yes/no); a counted habit has a plus button, Add one more
habits_list.grouping: by time block (Morning 06:30-09:00, Midday, Afternoon, Evening, Night), then Any time today; empty blocks still listed
habits_list.log_from_list: 1 tap: the checkbox, or the plus button for a count
habits_list.rule_seen: on the add-habit sheet, under a counted habit's daily number: 'A number you set for yourself. The row and the sheet count what you did; the number is shown once, in the sheet, and never as a fraction, a bar or a percentage.'
habits_list.switches: Tasks, Habits, Merged segments; By time and Day menus

habit_logging.form: popup over the list: note field above tick and cross buttons, 103x48 dp each

conflict_for_owner: T1's approved Today row for a counted habit reads '3 of 8 · next block 14:00', a fraction; Tendril's rule forbids fractions. Both forms are scored in T3.1.
